description: Store a user's selfie in a collection so they can be matched against its photos. Returns face_found, the selfie's point_id (use with search_by_point_id) and its 512-number embedding. face_found=false with reason=no_face means no face was found; a face that fails the quality gate (det_score < 0.6 or under 24 px) is refused with HTTP 422 and not stored. Retrying with the same idempotency_key returns the original point_id without a second charge. Costs 93 credits.

file_path.description: Path to the selfie on this computer (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF or HEIC).

gcs_key.description: Object key of the selfie on the CDN configured for your account (instead of a URL).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry that reuses the key is never charged twice: if the first call finished, the retry gets 409 duplicate_request_already_processed; if it is still running, 409 duplicate_request_in_flight. Use a new key for each different request.

image_base64.description: The selfie as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Up to 30 MB decoded. Prefer image_url for large files.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the selfie. SightRadar downloads it; it must be reachable from the internet.

selfie_id.description: Your id for this selfie. Defaults to a content hash.

name: register_selfie
